pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

Perfectly said by Doug.  Too good of an opportunity to pass up imo. 

“knots is prob the highest EV nanocap on sol at these levels. stonk/yield tokens reward people asymmetrically for getting a lot of supply at the lows. stonk is also down nearly 90% right now, meaning buying/holding KNOTS, you get disproprotionately more stonk down here on KNOTS volume than you do when stonk is trading higher. buying a lot of knots and treating it as an ultra-high-yield bond to earn stonk (which i believe goes back to ATH when the market turns around) feels like a kingmaker trade.

eventually when momentum rolls over, the idea is you sell your KNOTS, basically relinquishing it to the market for hopefully 10-20x what you paid down here, while also then sitting on a monster stack of free yield-earned stonk, that also goes up 5-10x from current levels (40m) back to 300m or beyond.

I still think stonk is a 10b protocol at the peak of a bull market. will be interesting to reevaluate all of this when btc is trading above 90k, let alone higher”
